metadata.title: Tropical Portrait Layout with Vertical Type Bar

recipe.visualDefinition: A warm-toned portrait of a man looking off-camera, framed by vertical organic textures like thin branches or reeds. The left side features a distinct vertical white bar containing bold, stacked typography, anchored by a series of small, colorful square texture swatches.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical reeds framing the subject's face and body
High-contrast white vertical text bar against a dark, textured background
Warm, golden-hour lighting on the subject contrasting with deep shadows
Repetitive beaded jewelry echoing the verticality of the reeds
coreInvariants: Presence of a multi-colored texture grid at the base of the text bar
Subject partially obscured by foreground elements
High saturation in skin tones and accent colors

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the right two-thirds of the frame, medium close-up scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical white text bar on the left serves as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright text on the left, moves down to the color swatches, then follows the subject's gaze toward the right edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows in the background and between the reeds provide negative space that emphasizes the subject's profile.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and blacks in the shadows and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for the primary vertical text block.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Earth tones (ochre, terracotta, forest green) in the texture swatches.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the warm highlights of the skin; low value in the surrounding environment.

composition.relationshipToImage: Contained in a white rectangular overlay

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact condensed sans-serif for the name paired with a delicate, traditional serif for the title.
graphicDevices: Calligraphic mark in the top left corner

avoid: Script fonts for the main name
Horizontal text for the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, vertical display style.
Provides the necessary serif contrast for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a warm-toned portrait of a man with a beard wearing multiple beaded necklaces, looking to the right. Frame the subject with thin, vertical brown reeds or branches in the foreground. The background should be dark and out of focus. Leave a clean vertical strip on the far left for graphic elements.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a solid white vertical rectangle on the left. Inside it, place large, black, condensed sans-serif text rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise. Below the text, add a stack of four small square images showing nature textures (green leaf, blue water, orange earth). Overlay a small gold serif title across the top of the squares.

verificationChecks: Is the main text rotated vertically?
Are there colorful texture swatches at the bottom of the white bar?
Is the subject framed by vertical organic elements?
Is the lighting warm and directional?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original person
Exact calligraphic signature in the corner

avoid: Horizontal text for the primary name

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white bar does not obscure the subject's face.
Check that the vertical text is legible and properly centered in the bar.
Verify the color swatches have distinct, organic textures.
Confirm the beaded jewelry adds to the vertical rhythm of the piece.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a vertical typographic sidebar with a foreground-framed portrait using warm, high-contrast lighting.
